top_choice_rationale: P004 credits a general physical-chemical principle, demixing of multivalent biomolecules above a saturation concentration, shown in embryos (Hyman, Brangwynne) and with purified components (Rosen) and quantitatively reproduced for fifteen years; the narrowed citation avoids claiming that all condensates are liquid. Among the slate, P001 is my next choice because induced proximity is a new, mechanistically measured principle with a single coherent citation (Crews, Deshaies, Handa). P003 splits that concept from base editing, whose deamination chemistry is classical, and P002 rests on an absorber story with open stability and early efficiency-measurement caveats. A prize is preferable to no award.
